learning_outcomes.text: Calculate the maximum resistance of machine elements in static and dynamic stress states.
Design and calculate shafts and power axles.
Select the most appropriate joining and support elements for shafts and axles.
Perform the calculation and design of power transmissions using flexible elements.
Perform the design and verification of gear wheels for a power transmission using gears.

syllabus_topics: BLOCK I: Fundamentals of machine technology
Topic 2: Calculation of machines by static resistance

assessment_methods.method: Report and development of Laboratory Practices
Activities on the virtual campus (two questionnaires)

assessment_rules: To pass the course, a total score equal to or greater than 5 out of 10 (50%) must be obtained. A minimum score of 40% in the final theoretical-practical exam is required. If the minimum is not reached, the qualification will be the minimum between the total calculated score and 4.0. For extraordinary calls, the same criteria apply, maintaining laboratory and classroom practice grades, and the exam also has a minimum score of 4 out of 10. For differentiated evaluation, a single exam covers expository classes and classroom practices (90%) and laboratory practices (10%).
